posts.caption:
@qataloghq set out to simplify the way teams worked by bringing company knowledge, tools and workflows into one intelligent platform. They needed content that could make those complex ideas easy to digest. 

A five-part video series was created to translate Qatalog’s vision into clear, educational and entertaining stories for its audience.

Qatalog went on to raise more than $25 million, with its technology used by teams at @nvidia, @twitter and @airbnb 

A few years later, it’s great to see how far the company has come - now acquired by @clickup and moving into its next chapter.

A good reminder that investing early in brand, storytelling and marketing can help ambitious companies move faster. 

Full project at tomlcollective.com/qatalog.

posts.caption:
New Read 📣

What looks like a resilience issue is often a conditions issue. And what gets labeled as burnout is sometimes something quieter - loneliness, disconnection, a life slowly reorganised around deliverables. 

Work becomes the obvious explanation because it’s measurable. Everything else that’s slowly disappearing usually isn’t. Burnout isn’t solved by asking people to recover faster. It’s solved by building ways of working they don’t constantly need to recover from.

The agencies navigating this better aren’t adding more wellness perks. They’re asking harder questions about how work is actually structured.

📖 Read the full piece on The Drum

posts.caption:
How do you make an global event campaign work across 14 international markets?

That was the brief from @ubs Asset Management for The Red Thread conference series: to help create a scalable campaign system that could could flex across the US, Europe and Asia.

In partnership with @unit9ltd , we produced an integrated global campaign across motion, video, digital, print and event creative.

The series proved to be a resounding success: participation increased by 52%, over 3,000 attendees engaged across the programme, and 42 experts helped strengthen UBS Asset Management’s position as a thought leader.

One global campaign, held together by one red thread.

posts.caption:
A 55-year-old financial brand doesn’t stay relevant by playing it safe.

To connect with a new generation of investors, @siebertfinancial needed more than a campaign. It needed a shift.

With Generation Wealth, we repositioned the brand for Gen Z and emerging investors by tapping into cultural insights, redefining the voice, and building a creative platform that feels modern, relatable, and credible.

From strategy to execution, we led the development of a full-scale campaign across digital and OOH designed to drive both connection and conversion.

Built to connect. Built to convert. Built to last.

Grateful to our partners @toml.collective & @fylle.ai for helping bring this to life.

Shoutout to our CMO Stefano Marrone, Senior Brand Manager Angie Obregon, and the entire Gebbia Media team for making it happen.
